Hmm, so on the yellow cross:

OK let me just accept that on the yellow cross, both LEFT and RIGHT move the cross LEFT. That seems like a bug or a weird mechanic. Let me focus on collecting dots.

But the player moves in steps of 3. From (27, 15), UP would go to (24, 15), then (21, 15), then (18, 15), then (15, 15). The dot at (17, 15) is not reachable in steps of 3.
Hmm, but maybe the cross collects dots when the cross arm overlaps the dot, not when the player reaches it. The vertical arm at col 15 goes from row 16 to 38. The dot at (17, 15) is at row 17, which is within the arm's range. So the cross should have already collected it if proximity is enough.
But the dot is still there. So maybe the cross doesn't automatically collect dots. Maybe I need to move the player to the dot's position.
But (17, 15) is not reachable in steps of 3 from (27, 15). 27 - 17 = 10, which is not divisible by 3.
Unless I shift the cross vertically first. If I shift the cross up by 1, the center would be at (26, 15), and the dot at (17, 15) would be 9 rows above, which is 3*3 = 9. So I could reach it with 3 UPs.
But how do I shift the cross vertically? UP at the center didn't work. Maybe I need to go to the end of the vertical arm and press UP to shift.
Let me try: go to the top of the vertical arm and press UP to shift the cross up.
The vertical arm top is at row 16. From center (27, 15), I need to go UP to (16, 15). But 27 - 16 = 11, not divisible by 3. So I can't reach the top in steps of 3.
Hmm, this is getting complicated. Let me try a different approach. Let me see if I can shift the cross vertically by going to the bottom of the arm and pressing DOWN.

Actually, I don't know if DOWN works on the yellow cross. Let me try it.
But wait, I also need to understand the UP behavior. UP at (27, 15) didn't move the player. Maybe UP is also a no-op on the yellow cross, like it was on the blue cross earlier.
Actually, on the blue cross, UP at the center DID work - it shifted the cross up. But on the yellow cross, UP didn't work.
Let me try DOWN on the yellow cross to see if it works.
